description: Yearly health activity using seven-day export buckets, overlap-safe cumulative totals, trends, vitals, hydration, and workout volume.

targets.rawSql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 week',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='weekly'),sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='raw')) AS value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='step_count' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(coalesce(sum(value),0))::bigint AS value FROM weekly;

WITH raw AS (SELECT make_date(${year:raw},1,1)+(((time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date-make_date(${year:raw},1,1))/7)*7 AS week,(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone') AS local_time,value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='walking_running_distance' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone')), weekly AS (SELECT week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE local_time=week::timestamp),sum(value)) AS value FROM raw GROUP BY week) SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM weekly;

WITH raw AS (SELECT make_date(${year:raw},1,1)+(((time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date-make_date(${year:raw},1,1))/7)*7 AS week,(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone') AS local_time,value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='active_energy' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone')), weekly AS (SELECT week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE local_time=week::timestamp),sum(value)) AS value FROM raw GROUP BY week) SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM weekly;

WITH raw AS (SELECT make_date(${year:raw},1,1)+(((time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date-make_date(${year:raw},1,1))/7)*7 AS week,(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone') AS local_time,value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='apple_exercise_time' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone')), weekly AS (SELECT week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE local_time=week::timestamp),sum(value)) AS value FROM raw GROUP BY week) SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM weekly;

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND start_time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone');

SELECT coalesce(sum(coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time)))/60,0) AS value FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND start_time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone');

WITH raw AS (SELECT make_date(${year:raw},1,1)+(((time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date-make_date(${year:raw},1,1))/7)*7 AS week,(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone') AS local_time,value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='basal_energy_burned' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone')), weekly AS (SELECT week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE local_time=week::timestamp),sum(value)) AS value FROM raw GROUP BY week) SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM weekly;

WITH raw AS (SELECT make_date(${year:raw},1,1)+(((time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone')::date-make_date(${year:raw},1,1))/7)*7 AS week,(time AT TIME ZONE '$timezone') AS local_time,metric,value FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('active_energy','basal_energy_burned') AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone')), weekly AS (SELECT week,metric,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE local_time=week::timestamp),sum(value)) AS value FROM raw GROUP BY week,metric) SELECT coalesce(sum(value),0) AS value FROM weekly;

panels.description: Auto Health Export groups a year range into seven-day buckets. A boundary aggregate is preferred over overlapping granular uploads in the same bucket.

targets.rawSql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 week',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='weekly'),sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='raw')) AS steps FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='step_count' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1) SELECT week AS time,steps AS "Weekly steps",avg(steps) OVER (ORDER BY week ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "4-week average" FROM weekly ORDER BY week;

panels.title: Weekly steps and trend

targets.rawSql: WITH weekly AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 week',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS week,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='weekly'),sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='raw')) AS steps FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='step_count' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1) SELECT week AS time,sum(coalesce(steps,0)) OVER (ORDER BY week ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Cumulative steps" FROM weekly ORDER BY week;

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS time,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='active_energy') AS "Active kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='basal_energy_burned') AS "Basal kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric IN ('active_energy','basal_energy_burned')) AS "Total kcal",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='walking_running_distance') AS "Distance miles" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('active_energy','basal_energy_burned','walking_running_distance') AND resolution='raw' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS time,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_exercise_time') AS "Exercise minutes",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_stand_time') AS "Stand minutes",sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='time_in_daylight') AS "Daylight minutes" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('apple_exercise_time','apple_stand_time','time_in_daylight') AND resolution='raw' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Monthly hydration totals and cumulative consumption for the selected year. Monthly rollup keeps historical weekly export buckets comparable with recent individual drink entries.

targets.rawSql: WITH hydration AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 month',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS month,coalesce(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution='weekly'),sum(value) FILTER (WHERE resolution IN ('raw','daily'))) AS ounces FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric='dietary_water' AND unit='fl_oz_us' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1) SELECT month AS time,ounces AS "Monthly water",sum(coalesce(ounces,0)) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Cumulative water" FROM hydration ORDER BY month;

panels.title: Water consumption by month

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',time,'$timezone')::date AS "Day",round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='resting_heart_rate')::numeric,1) AS "Resting HR",round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='respiratory_rate')::numeric,1) AS "Respiratory rate",round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='blood_oxygen_saturation')::numeric,1) AS "Blood oxygen %",round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='heart_rate_variability')::numeric,1) AS "HRV ms",round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='vo2_max')::numeric,1) AS "VO2 max" FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('resting_heart_rate','respiratory_rate','blood_oxygen_saturation','heart_rate_variability','vo2_max') AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('month',start_time,'$timezone') AS time,workout_type AS metric,sum(coalesce(duration_seconds,extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time)))/60 AS value FROM workouts WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND start_time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND start_time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH daily AS (SELECT time_bucket_gapfill('1 day',time,timezone=>'$timezone') AS day,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='step_count') AS steps,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='walking_running_distance') AS miles,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='active_energy') AS kcal,sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='apple_exercise_time') AS exercise FROM health_metrics WHERE user_id='$user_id'::uuid AND metric IN ('step_count','walking_running_distance','active_energy','apple_exercise_time') AND resolution='raw' AND time>=make_timestamptz(${year:raw},1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') AND time<make_timestamptz(${year:raw}+1,1,1,0,0,0,'$timezone') GROUP BY 1) SELECT day::date AS "Day",round(steps)::bigint AS "Steps",round(sum(coalesce(steps,0)) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING))::bigint AS "Cumulative steps",round(miles::numeric,2) AS "Miles",round(sum(coalesce(miles,0)) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)::numeric,2) AS "Cumulative miles",round(kcal::numeric) AS "Active kcal",round(sum(coalesce(kcal,0)) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)::numeric) AS "Cumulative kcal",round(exercise::numeric) AS "Exercise min" FROM daily ORDER BY day DESC;
